title: Figure 4: Alcubierre warp drive 'York Extrinsic Time Plot' 3D surface
description: Black-and-white 3D wireframe surface plot showing a sharp peak and trough in spacetime expansion, with axes labelled x, theta and (y²+z²)^1/2. Captioned "Figure 4. Warp Drive. Taken directly from the Frontiers book, this image has become the iconic representation for a warp drive: the 'York Extrinsic Time Plot.'" The text uses it to illustrate separation of outer and inner environments in a double-hull concept, followed by a section on field space drives.
